staticText: Blood Pressure Measurement Check for /tools/blood-pressure/. This is an adult, non-diagnostic context card for two readings taken at least 1 minute apart. It must never diagnose hypertension or pre-eclampsia; label a user normal, healthy, safe, controlled or in a disease stage; prescribe treatment, medication changes, diet or exercise; predict stroke or heart risk; average away a single high reading; or imply that technique explains away symptoms. General-adult and pregnancy/recent-postpartum boundaries must remain separate. WHO adult diagnosis requires qualifying measurements on two different days. Pregnancy or the first 6 weeks after birth uses a 140/90 maternity-contact boundary and 160/110 severe urgent-assessment boundary. Emergency symptoms require emergency help regardless of the numbers. The route is for adults aged 18 or over and must not interpret paediatric readings. Readings, context and symptom choices must not be stored, put in URLs, sent to analytics, uploaded, synced or require an account. TXT and PDF exports are local, user initiated and visibly contain sensitive health data.
